title: Real-Time Issues Investigator
description: Starts a constrained coding-agent investigation when Workers Observability reports a Real-Time Issue.

CLOUDFLARE_EVENTS.title: Cloudflare Event Subscriptions
CLOUDFLARE_EVENTS.description: The account Event Subscriptions connection that receives Real-Time Issue events.

CLOUDFLARE_OBSERVABILITY.title: Workers Observability
CLOUDFLARE_OBSERVABILITY.description: Read-only telemetry for the account that produced the issue.

GIT_REPOSITORY.title: GitHub repository
GIT_REPOSITORY.description: The only repository the investigator may inspect or modify.

INVESTIGATOR.title: Investigation agent
INVESTIGATOR.description: Agent Spawner restricted to the selected Observability and repository bindings.
